description: Send a message from one registered peer to another. The message is relayed by resuming the target's Claude Code session via CLI subprocess. Returns the target's response. Auto-recovers if the target's session has changed.

fromPeerId.description: Peer ID of the sender, e.g. 'backend'

message.description: The message content to send to the target peer

toPeerId.description: Peer ID of the recipient, e.g. 'frontend'

name: cc_send_message
title: Send Message to Peer
